topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, sets the context within the cancer lecture series, and outlines the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Concepts of Cancer Genesis and Epidemiological Variation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the core biology of cancer development and explore the relative contributions of intrinsic biological processes, genetics, and environmental exposures across populations.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Carcinogenesis and Tumour Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine specific infectious, physical, and chemical agents that drive cancer through direct DNA damage, metabolic activation, chronic inflammation, tumour promotion, and host developmental vulnerability.

topics.label: Methodologies for Detecting and Proving Carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the experimental, genomic, and epidemiological approaches used to identify carcinogens and evaluate their risks to human health.
